comments.text: Seeing miners carry nearly 200 lbs of sulfur out of the acidic Ijen crater with nothing more than a cloth over their mouths is deeply haunting. Some argue Indonesia should ban manual sulfur mining to protect human lives, while others claim it's their main livelihood when tourism alone isn't enough. Should the government step in with strict bans, or let them continue this traditional way of making a living?
